title: WarioWare: Get It Together!
subtitle: The characters enter the microgames
summary: WarioWare: Get It Together! is Intelligent Systems' Switch party game, released on 10 September 2021.
body: WarioWare: Get It Together! is Intelligent Systems' Switch party game, released on 10 September 2021. Wario and his friends are pulled inside their latest game device and must take part in its rapid microgames themselves. A short instruction appears, a few seconds are available and the chosen character has to make the necessary change on screen. The familiar WarioWare rhythm remains, but the cast now stands between the player's input and the task, turning character abilities into a new source of variation.

A direction stick and one button control the action, but each character uses them differently. Wario flies and shoulder-charges, while 18-Volt throws discs from a fixed position and moves by catching rings. The same microgame can therefore require a different solution when another character appears. A target might be reached through direct contact or a projectile, depending on the current member of the crew. Success demands reading the brief instruction and immediately translating it into the tools that particular character can provide.

The story can be played cooperatively by two people, with further party activities supporting up to four. A growing cast and challenge modes give completed microgames new combinations of abilities and constraints. Ko Takeuchi and Waki Shigeta's character art preserves the series' expressive, comic identity. The central change is small but far-reaching: each miniature task now has both a rule and a performer. Learning the cast becomes another way to improve at the games, and a familiar instruction can feel new when it arrives with an inconvenient character.
